K2 and the twin were submitted 6 s apart and the twin runs about 0.5 h shorter, so it normally scores first. The finding has almost no score value; it is pre-registration hygiene that stops an ad-hoc choice after the score. Feasibility is trivial: one pre-score CONTEXT line, no build, no GPU, within R1-R10. That gives F1 = #34, a byte copy of x138, even when the twin scored >= 0.953, because R3-A9 item (4) covers only the case where lowrefine leaves F1.
